page.layout: One printed page, the index on the left part of the scan, with a heading INDEX at the top, numbered entries with page numbers at the right end of each entry, and the closing line FINIS INDICIS below. The right part of the scan is the dark book cover and background, not printed text.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.l: VII. Vtrum sciri possit ex quibus mundi partibus ventisflent, & quotnam sint numero venti 596
VIII. An sint quidam ventisflati, qui continuis aliquot mensibus ab una mundi plaga spirent 598
IX. Quomodo pixis nautica fabrefacta sit, & quis sit eius vsus 600
X. Qua causa fit, cur vela earumque antenna quo altius malo affiguntur, eo velocius navim impellant, & cur tam exiguo gubernaculi ligno tanta navium moles promoveatur 602
XI. Qua & quanta fuerit apud veteres navigandi peritia 604
XII. An Exuviis piscis navigia retardet, & nonnulla etiam de Nauτίλῳ pisce 606

page.notes: The page numbers at the right of the entries are partly smudged; 596, 598, 600, 602, 604 and 606 are as read. The Greek word in entry XII (Nautilo) is written in Greek letters and is only approximately read. The FINIS line is centred in larger capitals below the index.
